_comment: 'slug' is the folder under /clients/ and must match the path a Cloudflare Access policy covers.
'drive' is a Google Drive folder shared directly with that customer.
'emails' is documentation only — Cloudflare holds the real portal allowlist, and Google holds the real file allowlist.
IMPORTANT: share the Drive folder with the SAME address the customer signs into the portal with, or they will reach the page and then be refused by Drive.

drive.label: Your catalogues
drive.note: Paste the Google Drive folder link here, then share that folder with the address above.
